top.title: Etihad Rail announces more trains between Abu Dhabi and Dubai to meet demand
top.teaser: Etihad Rail has added more than 2,000 tickets across six extra train services between Abu Dhabi and Dubai this weekend. The additional services were announced on Friday and were made available after the new passenger rail route connecting the UAE's biggest cities attracted “exceptional early demand”. top.title: Etihad Rail stations host dazzling laser shows to celebrate network expansion
top.teaser: Spectacular laser shows were held at Etihad Rail stations across the Emirates on Friday evening to signal the growth of the passenger rail network. top.title: UAE Property: 'Who pays to install an EV charger at a rented villa?'
top.teaser: Question: I rent a villa in Dubai and recently bought an electric car.
